_about: Hand model: which finger movements are physically possible, and what makes a fingering awkward. Used by hand.js to choose fingers for any shape that is not in fingerings.json, and to reject shapes no hand can play.
_maxSpan: Highest minus lowest fretted fret in one shape (index on fret n, pinky up to n + 3).
_maxExtraStretch: Two fingers may be one fret further apart than their finger numbers (fingers 1 and 2 may cover frets 1 and 3).

barre._about: One finger pressing several strings on one fret. The index may lie across strings fretted higher by other fingers; fingers 2–4 only across strings at exactly the barre fret.

costs._offPosition: Per fret, for the first note on each fret: distance from 'one finger per fret' (index on the lowest fret).
costs._crossedOnFret: Two fingers on one fret where the lower string has the higher finger number.
costs._crowded: Three or four different fingers squeezed onto one fret (four usually means: use a barre).
